speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see this newborn is presenting with increasing yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin; to begin our assessment, how many days old is the baby, and when did you first notice the jaundice?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (likely due to insufficient intake/dehydration), though I need to rule out hemolysis. To confirm, please request a Blood Test: Total Serum Bilirubin, Direct Bilirubin, and CBC with Reticulocyte Count. Also, REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal Ultrasound to assess for biliary atresia if direct hyperbilirubinemia is found.
